DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどなたと、どのくらい歩くご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Who are you walking with today, and how far do you plan to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 散歩に慣れていない友人と二人です。一周すると途中で疲れても、最後まで歩かないと戻れませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散歩に不慣れな友人と二人で、一周路では途中で戻れないのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two of us, my friend who is not used to walks and me. On a loop, if we get tired partway, must we finish the whole route to return?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are with a friend unused to walks and ask whether a loop prevents returning partway. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一周にこだわらず、同じ道を戻る案があります。この案内図では、入口から休憩広場までが分岐の少ない道です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can return along the same path without insisting on a loop. On this map, the route from the entrance to the rest plaza has few forks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その往復にしたいです。広場まで行けるかまだわからないので、途中で座れる場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 往復路を選び、広場まで行けるか不明なので手前の休憩場所も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We would like that return walk. We do not yet know whether we can reach the plaza, so please show places to sit before it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the out-and-back route and ask about earlier rest spots because reaching the plaza is uncertain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図の四角い印がベンチです。広場より手前にもあります。入口へ戻るときは、来た道を逆にたどります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The square symbols are benches. There are some before the plaza too. Return to the entrance by retracing your path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四角い印は建物かと思いました。ベンチなのですね。戻る方向を、図に矢印で書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四角い印を建物と誤解していたと伝え、入口へ戻る矢印を図に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought the squares were buildings. They are benches, then. Could you draw arrows on the map showing the return direction?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook square symbols for buildings and request arrows back to the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、こちらが入口へ戻る向きです。広場から先の細い道には、今回の往復では入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, this is the direction back to the entrance. You will not enter the narrow path beyond the plaza on this return walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 細い道へは進まず、同じ道を戻ります。友人が手前のベンチで休みたいと言ったら、広場まで行かず引き返してもよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 細い道へ入らず、友人が手前で疲れたら広場まで行かず戻ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will avoid the narrow path and return the same way. If my friend wants to rest at an earlier bench, we can turn back without reaching the plaza, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm avoiding the narrow path and returning before the plaza if your friend tires earlier. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もちろんです。決めた距離より、お二人の体調を優先してください。案内図はお持ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. Put your health above the planned distance. Would you like a map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一枚ください。友人にもベンチの印と戻る矢印を見せて、行けるところまでの往復にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内図一枚を求め、友人とベンチと戻る矢印を確認して距離を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: One, please. I will show my friend the bench symbols and return arrows, and we will go only as far as we can and back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request one map and say you will check benches and return arrows with your friend to decide the distance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの案内図をどうぞ。迷ったときに細い道へ進まず、この案内所に相談してください。無理のない範囲でお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the map. If unsure, consult this information desk rather than entering the narrow path. Enjoy yourselves within your abilities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発車する順番のことで、案内を聞き直したいとのことですね。どちらの列車をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to hear the departure-order guidance again. Which train are you considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事で品物を受け取りに行きます。私の列車が遅れているので、いま放送された先に出る列車に乗れば早く着くと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事の受取へ向かう列車が遅れ、放送された先発列車なら早着できると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to collect goods for work. My train is delayed, so I thought taking the train just announced as departing first would get me there earlier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your train to a work collection is delayed and you thought the announced earlier departure would arrive sooner. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先に出ても、同じ駅に停まるとは限りません。降りる予定の駅が分かる物と、切符を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Departing first does not guarantee stopping at the same station. May I see your ticket and something showing the station where you plan to get off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受け取り先のメモと切符があります。放送では行先しか聞き取れず、途中の停車駅は確かめていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取先の駅のメモと切符を示し、放送の行先だけ聞いて途中の停車駅は未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my ticket and a note of the collection destination. I only caught the destination in the announcement and did not check intermediate stops.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the destination-station note and ticket, and explain that you heard only the final destination and have not checked intermediate stops. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このメモの駅に停まるか、列車ごとの案内で確認します。受け取りの時刻は変更できないお約束でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check each train's information for the station on this note. Is your collection appointment fixed and unchangeable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手は午後なら対応できると言っていましたが、閉める時刻までは聞いていません。先に、遅れる可能性と受け取れる時間を電話で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 午後対応可能と聞いたが終了時刻は不明で、遅延可能性と受取可能時間を電話で確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: They said they could help in the afternoon, but I did not ask their closing time. First I will call about a possible delay and the available collection times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say afternoon service was offered but closing time is unknown, and you will call about possible delay and collection hours. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 時間に幅があるか分かれば、停車駅と到着見込みを合わせて候補を考えられます。別の列車を使う場合は切符の扱いも確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once we know the flexibility, we can consider options using stops and estimated arrivals together. Using a different train also requires checking your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受け取り先から、今日は急がなくてよく、来られる見込みが立ったら連絡してほしいと返事が来ました。先発の列車に慌てて乗るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 急がず見込みが立ったら連絡してよいとの返事を伝え、慌てて先発へ乗るのをやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: They replied that I need not hurry today and should contact them once I know when I can come. I will not rush onto the first-departing train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Relay that there is no need to hurry and you may contact them when plans are clearer, and stop rushing for the earlier train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。停車駅の確認後に、切符をそのまま使えるかも調べます。お待ちの列車の運行情報も変わることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. After checking stops, we will check whether your ticket can be used unchanged. Information for the train you are waiting for may also change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停車駅と切符の条件が確認できてから選びたいです。受け取り先には、次の案内を聞いた後で見込みを伝え、今は到着を約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停車駅と切符条件の確認後に選び、次の案内後に受取先へ見込みを伝え今は到着を約束しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want to choose after the stops and ticket conditions are confirmed. I will give the collection contact an estimate after the next guidance, and will not promise arrival now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will choose after checking stops and ticket conditions, give the collection contact an estimate after the next guidance, and not promise arrival now. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、先発の列車の停車案内から照合します。まだ列車はお決めにならず、切符とメモをお手元にこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's compare the earlier train's stopping information first. Do not decide on a train yet; wait here with your ticket and note to hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の変更についてのお問い合わせですね。現在の予約案内はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about changing an appointment. Do you have the current appointment information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この相談予約の日に仕事が入りました。取り消すと、先週出した申請そのものも取り消されるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事で相談日に行けず、予約を取り消すと先週の申請自体も取り消されるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I now have work on this consultation day. If I cancel the appointment, will the application I submitted last week be canceled too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say work prevents attending the consultation and ask whether canceling the appointment also cancels last week's application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談の予約と申請の扱いは分けて担当へ確認します。申請について、最近通知などは届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the consultation appointment and application separately with the responsible staff. Have you received any recent application notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 追加の書類を求める通知が来ています。予約の日に持っていくつもりでしたが、期限の欄はまだよく読めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加書類の通知があり予約日に持参予定だが、期限欄はまだ理解できていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I received a notice requesting additional documents. I planned to bring them on the appointment day, but have not properly understood the deadline section yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say there is an additional-document notice and you planned to bring them to the appointment, but do not yet understand the deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約変更だけで書類の期限も変わるとは限りません。通知を拝見して、担当へ期限と提出方法を照会しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Changing an appointment does not necessarily change document deadlines. Let's look at the notice and ask the responsible staff about the deadline and submission method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。新しい相談日が決まるまで通知を置いたままにせず、予約とは別に書類への対応が必要か知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新相談日を待って通知を放置せず、予約と別に書類対応が必要か確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I do not want to leave the notice unattended until a new consultation day is set. I want to know whether document action is needed separately from the appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to check whether document action is needed separately, without leaving the notice until a new appointment is set. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も確認します。日時を変えるに当たり、前の予約でお願いしていた支援などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check that too. When changing the time, was any support requested for your previous appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベトナム語の支援を相談していました。新しい日にも同じように利用できると思わず、支援の調整も含めて空きを確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 以前相談したベトナム語支援を新日程でも使えると決めず、支援調整を含めて空きを照会してほしいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I had discussed Vietnamese-language support. Please check availability including support arrangements, rather than assuming the same support is available on the new day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you do not assume previously discussed Vietnamese support is available on the new day, and request availability checking including support coordination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約の変更方法と支援の利用可否を調べます。お仕事の予定から、希望できる時間帯をいくつか挙げていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check how to change the appointment and whether support is available. Could you suggest several possible time slots around work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 平日の午前なら二日候補があります。候補をメモでお渡ししますので、元の予約をどう扱うかも確認し、変更が確定した日時を控えて帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 平日午前の二候補をメモで渡し、元予約の扱いと変更確定日時を確認して控えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have two possible weekday mornings. I will give you a note of them. Please also check what happens to the original appointment, and I want to take home the confirmed new date and time in writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Provide two weekday-morning options in a note and ask to check the original appointment's handling and record the confirmed new time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 候補のメモと予約案内をお預かりして照会します。申請の状態、書類の期限、予約の変更を順に分けてご案内しますのでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take your options note and appointment information to inquire. Please wait; we will explain application status, document deadlines, and appointment changes separately in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手元の予約票を見ながら、職場に出す書類についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about documents for your workplace while looking at your appointment slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日払った分の領収書が見つかりません。職場で費用を精算するのに、この次回の予約票を出せば代わりになるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日の領収書をなくし、職場の精算に次回予約票で代用できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot find today's payment receipt. For reimbursement at work, can I submit this next-appointment slip instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you lost today's receipt and ask whether the next appointment slip can substitute for workplace reimbursement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票は次回の予定を示す物で、今日の支払額を証明する書類とは別です。職場から必要な書類名を指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The appointment slip shows a future visit and differs from proof of today's payment amount. Has your workplace specified the document's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には領収書とあります。予約票にも病院名があるので十分だと思いましたが、払った金額は書かれていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 職場の指定は領収書で、予約票の病院名だけで十分と思ったが金額がないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions say receipt. I thought the hospital name on the appointment slip was enough, but it does not show the amount paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say work specifies a receipt; you thought the hospital name on the appointment slip was enough, but it lacks the amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職場に受け付けてもらえる書類と、こちらで用意できる物をそれぞれ確認する必要があります。領収書の写真や控えは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check separately what your workplace accepts and what we can prepare. Do you still have a receipt photo or copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯に撮った写真があります。職場が写真でもよいかは聞いていません。病院へは、なくした場合の相談先を案内してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 携帯の写真は残るが職場の画像受理は未確認と伝え、紛失時の病院相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a photo on my phone. I have not asked whether work accepts photos. Please tell me whom at the hospital to consult about a lost receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say a phone photo remains but workplace acceptance of images is unconfirmed, and ask for the hospital's lost-receipt contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会計担当へ取り次ぎます。再発行などの取扱いは担当が確認しますので、私から今すぐ出せるとは申し上げられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will refer you to billing. The responsible staff will check reissue and other arrangements, so I cannot say it can be issued immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その場でもらえると決めず、可能な書類と費用、受取時期を会計で尋ねます。職場にも写真でよいか先に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 即時交付と決めず会計で書類可否・費用・時期を聞き、職場にも写真でよいか連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume immediate issue. I will ask billing about available documents, costs, and collection time. I will also contact work first about accepting the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume immediate issue, will ask billing about documents, cost, and timing, and contact work about the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように分けてご確認ください。会計担当へ伝えるため、お支払いになったのは本日の受診分だけか伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check those separately. To tell billing, may I ask whether you paid only for today's consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、今日の受診分です。写真を見せて支払いの確認をお願いし、予約票を支払証明だと職場へ出すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の受診分の支払と答え、写真で確認を頼み、予約票を支払証明として提出しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, today's consultation. I will show the photo and ask for the payment to be checked, and will not submit the appointment slip to work as payment proof.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm payment was for today's consultation, request checking with the photo, and say you will not submit the appointment slip as payment proof. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、本日の書類のご相談として会計へおつなぎします。予約票と写真をお手元に、担当からの案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you to billing about today's documents. Keep the appointment slip and photo to hand and wait for their guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昼食用の袋が見当たらないというご相談ですね。袋には、どのような物を入れていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You cannot find your lunch bag. What was inside it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 布の袋に弁当箱を入れていました。今思い出したのですが、内側のポケットに社員証も入れたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 弁当箱入りの布袋をなくし、内ポケットの社員証も入れたままだと思い出して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A lunchbox in a cloth bag. I just remembered that my employee ID is still in its inner pocket too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you lost a cloth bag containing a lunchbox and remembered that your employee ID remained in the inner pocket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋を最後に見たのはどこでしょうか。なくしたと思う場所と、実際に見た場所を分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you last see the bag? Distinguish where you think you lost it from where you actually saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼休みにベンチから立つときは足元にありました。その後に店へ寄ったので店で落としたと思いましたが、店内で見た覚えはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチを立つ時には袋があった事実と、その後の店で落とした推測を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was by my feet when I stood up from the bench at lunch. I visited a shop afterward, so thought I dropped it there, but do not remember seeing it inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the fact that the bag was there when leaving the bench from the guess that it was dropped in the shop afterward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の模様や社員証の入れ方など、見分けられる特徴を伺います。会社名などは用紙で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please describe identifying features such as the bag's pattern and how the ID was stored. We will check the company name and similar details on the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋は緑の無地で、持ち手の片方に黄色い糸で縫った跡があります。社員証は透明のケースに入れ、内ポケットにしまっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 緑無地の袋の持ち手の黄色い縫い跡と、内ポケットの透明ケース入り社員証を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The bag is plain green, with yellow stitching on one handle. The employee ID is in a transparent case inside the inner pocket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe a plain green bag with yellow stitching on one handle, and an employee ID in a clear case in the inner pocket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴で相談を進めます。社員証の扱いや職場に入る方法について、会社には連絡なさいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will proceed using those features. Have you contacted your company about the ID and how to enter work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ連絡していません。ここで届け出れば社員証も使えなくなると思っていましたが、職場の担当へ別に知らせたほうがよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社未連絡で警察届出が社員証停止になると思っていたと述べ、職場への別連絡を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I thought reporting here would disable the employee ID too, but I should notify the workplace separately, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the company has not been contacted, you thought a police report disabled the ID, and check separate workplace notification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 警察への届出で、社員証の利用状態が自動的に変わるわけではありません。職場の担当に紛失を伝え、必要な対応をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: A police report does not automatically change an employee ID's usage status. Tell the responsible workplace staff about the loss and check what to do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今から職場へも連絡して入館方法を相談します。こちらには袋と社員証の両方を届け出たいので、見つかった時の連絡先を登録したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 職場へ入館方法も相談し、警察には袋と社員証の両方を届けて発見時の連絡先を登録したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact work now and ask how to enter. I want to report both the bag and ID here, and register a contact for when they are found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask work about entry and report both bag and ID to police, registering a contact for discovery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、袋の特徴と中身、連絡先を分けて記入しましょう。会社への連絡も進めながら、こちらで届出の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's enter the bag's features, contents, and contact details separately. Follow the reporting guidance here while also contacting your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票の期限が過ぎたかもしれないということですね。どの日付をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You think the missed-delivery notice's deadline may have passed. Which date did you look at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この日付が昨日なので、もう荷物は送り返されたと思いました。明日から出張で家にいないため、受け取れるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票の日付が昨日なので返送済みと思い、明日から出張で受取が心配と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This date is yesterday, so I thought the parcel had already been returned. I leave on a business trip tomorrow and will be away, so I am worried about receiving it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that yesterday's date made you think the parcel was returned, and you are worried because a business trip starts tomorrow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは配達に伺った日の欄です。保管期限の欄は別にありますので、番号と合わせて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field is the attempted delivery date. There is a separate holding deadline; let's check that and the number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 配達日と期限を取り違えていました。まだ受け取れる状態か、この番号で調べていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配達日と保管期限を取り違えたと認め、番号で現在受取可能な状態か調べてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I confused the delivery date and deadline. Could you check with this number whether it can still be collected?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit confusing delivery date and holding deadline, and request a check by number of whether collection is still possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際の保管状況を照会します。出張中は、ご自身が再配達を受けられる日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will inquire about actual storage status. Are there any days during your trip when you can receive redelivery yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出張中は家に戻りません。帰るまで保管してもらえるなら助かりますが、自動的に延長されるわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出張中は戻らず帰宅までの保管を希望するが、自動延長ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not return home during the trip. It would help if they could hold it until I return, but that is not automatically extended, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not return during the trip and want holding until your return, but confirm extension is not automatic. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 延長できるかを含め、荷物の条件によって確認が必要です。ほかに受取を頼めそうな方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We need to check the parcel's conditions, including whether extension is possible. Is there anyone else you might ask to receive it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同居の家族はいますが、まだ頼んでいません。家族なら必ず受け取れると思わず、必要な条件と持ち物を知ってから相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同居家族には未依頼で、必ず代理受取可能と決めず条件と持ち物を知ってから相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I live with family, but have not asked them yet. I will not assume family can always collect it; I want to know the conditions and required items before asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say cohabiting family has not been asked and you will not assume proxy collection is possible, but want conditions and required items first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の受取、代理の受取、保管について順に確認します。いずれもご希望に合わない場合には、差出人との相談が必要になることもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check personal collection, proxy collection, then holding. If none suits you, consultation with the sender may be needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず今の荷物の状態と使える方法を教えてください。出張後まで待てない場合は、差出人にも連絡し、延長できたとは決めつけず予定を立てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在状態と利用方法を先に聞き、帰宅まで待てないなら差出人にも相談し延長済みと決めず予定を立てる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: First tell me the parcel's current status and available methods. If it cannot wait until I return, I will contact the sender too and plan without assuming an extension has been granted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask current status and options first, and if it cannot wait until return, consult the sender and plan without assuming extension. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では番号の照会を進めます。方法が確定するまでは別の申込みをせず、不在票をお手元にお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the number. Until a method is confirmed, do not make another request; wait with the notice to hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの名義は、お越しのご本人様でしょうか。どなたのカードについてのご相談か伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the card in your own name? Whose card are you consulting about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父のカードです。父に頼まれて家で探しましたが見つからず、私が家族として利用停止と再発行を頼めると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父に頼まれ家で探したがカードがなく、家族として停止と再発行を頼めると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father's. He asked me to look at home, but I could not find it. I came thinking family could request suspension and reissue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your father asked you to search at home without finding the card, and you thought family could request suspension and reissue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お父様ご本人は今、こちらでお話しできる状況でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is your father able to speak with us here now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は来店していません。電話で話すことはできますが、私はカードの番号を知りません。番号がなくても、どのように相談すればよいか教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 父は来店せず電話で話せるが番号は分からないと伝え、番号なしの相談方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: He has not come today. He can talk by phone, but I do not know the card number. Could you explain how to consult without the number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your father is absent but can speak by phone, you do not know the number, and ask how to consult without it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一般的な相談は伺えますが、個別の手続きや情報の確認には条件があります。ご家族というだけで全てのお手続きができるとは申し上げられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can hear general questions, but individual procedures and information checks have conditions. Being family does not mean you can complete every procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父の取引内容をここで見せてほしいわけではありません。本人から連絡する方法と、私が手伝える範囲を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父の取引開示ではなく、本人から連絡する方法と家族が手伝える範囲を知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am not asking to see my father's transactions here. I want to know how he can contact you himself and what I can help with.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you seek contact methods for your father and the scope of family assistance, rather than disclosure of his transactions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。ご本人へ連絡方法をお伝えできるよう、案内を一緒に整理しましょう。暗証番号を聞き出してお持ちになる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check with the responsible staff. Let's organize the guidance so you can tell him how to contact us. You do not need to obtain and bring his PIN.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 暗証番号は父から聞きません。本人が連絡できる方法を先に伝え、私が代わって電話すれば本人確認も済むとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 父から暗証番号を聞かず連絡方法を伝え、代わりの電話だけで本人確認完了とは考えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not ask my father for his PIN. I will tell him how he can contact you first, and will not assume a call in his place completes identity verification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not ask your father's PIN, will relay contact methods, and will not assume a proxy call completes identity checks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再発行についても、紛失への対応とは別に条件や費用の確認が必要です。本日、再発行まで決めたいというご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Reissue also requires checking conditions and costs separately from handling loss. Do you want to decide on reissue today too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず父が紛失の対応を相談できるようにしたいです。再発行の費用や受取方法は父と確認し、今日は停止も再発行も完了したとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: まず父の紛失相談を優先し、再発行費用や受取は父と確認して停止や再発行完了とは伝えないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I want my father to be able to consult about the loss. I will check reissue costs and collection with him, and will not tell him suspension or reissue is complete today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prioritize your father's loss consultation, say costs and collection will be checked with him, and do not claim suspension or reissue is complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご本人からの相談方法を担当に照会します。お渡しするのはご案内ですので、手続きが完了したかは、担当からの説明でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will ask the responsible staff how the cardholder can consult. What we give you is guidance; check completion of any procedure from their explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 整理箱の中に、入っていない物があるというご相談ですね。何が不足しているように見えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You think something is missing from the organizer box. What appeared to be missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った整理箱に、写真の小さい仕切りがありません。写真と同じように文房具を分けたかったので、入れ忘れかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の整理箱に写真の小仕切りがなく、文房具を分けるつもりだったため入れ忘れか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The small dividers in the photo were not in the organizer I bought yesterday. I wanted to separate stationery as shown, so wondered whether they were left out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say yesterday's organizer lacks the pictured small dividers and ask whether they were omitted, as you wanted to separate stationery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外箱と購入の分かる物はお持ちでしょうか。写真のそばの説明と、付属品の欄を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the outer box and proof of purchase? I want to check the description near the photo and the accessories list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外箱とレシートを持ってきました。写真だけ見て選んだので、下の小さな説明はまだ読めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外箱とレシートを示し、写真で選んで小さな説明は読めていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought the box and receipt. I chose from the photo alone and have not read the small description below.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the box and receipt, and say you chose from the photo without reading the small description. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここには使用例とあります。付属品に何が含まれるかは、別の欄に書かれていますので、その記載と現物を比べてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This says 'example of use.' Included accessories are listed elsewhere; let's compare that list with the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使用例なら、写っている物が全部付くとは限らないのですね。箱に書かれた数と、持ってきた中身を一緒に数えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使用例の写真全てが付属とは限らないと確認し、記載数と現物を一緒に数えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So a usage example does not mean everything pictured is included. Could you count the number on the box together with the contents I brought?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that not everything in a usage photo is necessarily included and request counting the listed number against actual items together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記載された部品がそろっているか確認します。写真の仕切りが別売かどうかも調べますが、ご希望は不足分の確認でしょうか、それとも追加購入でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check whether all listed parts are present. We will also check whether the pictured dividers are sold separately. Do you want a shortage check or an additional purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず本来の付属品が足りているかを知りたいです。別売なら、値段とこの箱に合うかを聞いてから買うか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本来の部品不足を先に確認し、別売なら価格と適合性を聞いて追加購入を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: First I want to know whether all original accessories are there. If sold separately, I will decide whether to buy after hearing the price and whether they fit this box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask first about missing original parts, and say you will decide on extras after checking price and compatibility if sold separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。部品が実際に足りない場合の対応も確認します。外箱や部品は、その確認が終わるまでそろえてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will also check what to do if parts really are missing. Keep the box and parts together until checking is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 外箱と今ある部品はまとめて保管します。写真と違うだけで交換できると決めず、付属品の照合結果と別売品の案内を聞いてから希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱と部品を保管し写真との差だけで交換可能と決めず、付属品照合と別売案内後に希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the box and existing parts together. I will not assume an exchange is possible just because it differs from the photo; I will state my preference after the accessory check and separate-item guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep box and parts, not assume exchange from photo differences alone, and state preferences after accessory checking and separate-item guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、付属品欄に沿って現物を確認します。レシートもお返しするまでこちらで保管しますので、少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check the actual items against the accessories list. We will also keep the receipt here until returning it, so please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ゆっくり歩ける場所をお探しですね。広さのほかに、避けたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want somewhere to walk slowly. Besides space, is there anything you want to avoid?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 速く歩く人や自転車が多いと落ち着かないので、静かな道がよいです。この広い道なら、歩く人だけだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 速い歩行者や自転車が多いと落ち着かず静かな道を希望し、広い道は歩行者専用と思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Fast walkers and many bicycles make me uneasy, so I prefer a quiet path. I thought this wide path was pedestrians only.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say fast walkers and bicycles make you uneasy, you want a quiet route, and thought the wide path was pedestrian-only. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 広い道が歩行者だけとは限りません。この図の自転車の印は、共用の道を示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: A wide path is not necessarily pedestrians only. The bicycle symbol on this map indicates a shared path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自転車の印を見落としていました。誰もいない所でなくても構いませんが、共用の道を長く歩くのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自転車印を見落としたと認め、無人でなくてもよいが共用道を長く歩くのは避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I overlooked the bicycle symbol. It need not be deserted, but I want to avoid a long walk on a shared path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit overlooking the bicycle symbol, and say the route need not be empty but you want to avoid walking far on a shared path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の歩行経路の表示を見てみましょう。ただ、今日は広場で催しの案内が出ているので、周辺は人の動きが変わる可能性があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's look at other walking-route signs. There is an event notice for the plaza today, however, so movement around it may change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その広場を通れば近道になると思っていました。催しの様子を知らないので、静かだと決めて通らず、広場を避けた短い範囲を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 広場の近道を考えたが催しの状況は不明なので静かと決めず、広場を避ける短い範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought going through the plaza was a shortcut. I do not know the event conditions, so will not assume it is quiet. I want a short area avoiding the plaza.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you considered a plaza shortcut but event conditions are unknown, so ask for a short area avoiding it without assuming quiet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口寄りの道を図で確認できます。現在の混み具合は分からないため、現地で様子を見て、難しそうなら引き返すこともお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check the path near the entrance on the map. We do not know current crowding, so observe conditions there and consider turning back if difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口の近くで様子を見て、落ち着いて歩けなければ今日は短く切り上げます。途中で座って休む場所の表示も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口付近で様子を見て落ち着かなければ切り上げ、休憩場所の印も教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look near the entrance, and if I cannot walk calmly, end the walk early today. Please show rest-area symbols along the way too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will observe near the entrance and finish early if uneasy, and ask about rest symbols. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩場所の印はこちらですが、空席をお約束はできません。戻る入口は、この案内所のある所でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The rest-area symbol is here, but we cannot promise a free seat. Will you return to the entrance where this information desk is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 座れることを前提に遠くへ行かず、この案内所の入口へ戻ります。図の現在地と戻る道を確かめてから、近くの散歩を始めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 空席を前提に遠くへ行かず案内所の入口へ戻り、現在地と帰路を確認後に近くを歩きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not go far assuming I can sit, and will return to this information-desk entrance. I want to check our position and return path on the map before starting a nearby walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not go far assuming seats, will return to the information-desk entrance, and check the current location and return path before walking nearby. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、共用の道と広場を除いた範囲を図で指して確認しましょう。混み具合に応じて無理をせず、お戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's point out and check the area excluding the shared path and plaza on the map. Return without overdoing it according to the crowds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 往復でお出かけになる切符でしょうか。お帰りも、行きと同じ日をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a return ticket? Are you also thinking of returning on the same day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 催しへ行って、その夜に帰るつもりです。終わるのが遅いので、夜中を過ぎても日帰りの切符でよいのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜の催し後に帰る予定だが、夜中を過ぎても日帰りの切符でよいか迷うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to attend an event and return that night. It finishes late, so I am unsure whether a day-return ticket is still suitable after midnight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you will return after a late event but are unsure whether a day-return ticket is suitable past midnight. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付をまたぐかどうかと、実際に乗れる列車は分けて確認しましょう。催しの終了予定と目的の駅を示す物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check crossing the date boundary separately from trains you can actually take. Do you have something showing the event's expected finish and destination station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内に終了予定があります。ただ、片付けを手伝うので駅に着く時刻はまだ読めません。帰りの列車があるかも調べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 終了予定を示し、片付けで駅到着時刻が読めず帰路の列車も未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The planned finish is in this guide. But I will help clean up, so cannot estimate when I will reach the station. I have not checked whether a return train exists either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the expected finish, and explain that cleanup makes station-arrival time uncertain and return trains are unchecked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず帰路の候補を確認する必要があります。帰る時刻が定まらないまま、日付や列車の決まった商品を選ぶのは避けたほうがよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We first need to check return options. It would be better to avoid choosing a fixed-date or fixed-train product while your return time is unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 安そうな往復の商品を先に選ぼうとしていましたが、購入は待ちます。帰りが翌日になった場合も含めて、利用条件を比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 安そうな往復商品を先に選ばず、翌日帰りも含め条件を比較したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was about to choose a seemingly cheap return product first, but will wait to buy. I want to compare conditions including a return the following day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not first select a cheap-looking return product, and want to compare conditions including next-day return. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 券種ごとの条件と合計額を確認します。催しの主催者に、片付けが終わる目安や途中で帰れるかを尋ねられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check each ticket type's conditions and total. Could you ask the organizer about likely cleanup completion and whether you can leave partway?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 主催者へ聞いてみます。もし列車で帰れない時間になるなら、泊まるか参加時間を短くするかを決めてから切符を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 主催者に片付けの目安を聞き、列車に間に合わないなら宿泊か短時間参加を決めてから購入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask. If it would be too late to return by train, I will decide whether to stay overnight or shorten my attendance before buying tickets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the organizer about cleanup timing and, if trains are unavailable, decide overnight stay or shorter attendance before buying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予定がまとまったら、帰りに乗る日付をはっきりさせて照会しましょう。今は運行の候補を確認するだけでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once plans are settled, let's inquire with a clear return travel date. For now, is checking service options enough?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、今日は行きと帰りの候補を聞くだけにします。日付が変わっても同じ扱いだと決めず、予定と券種の条件が合うか購入前に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は往復候補の照会だけにし、日付変更も同じ扱いと決めず予定と券種を購入前に照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, today I will only ask about outward and return options. I will not assume the same rules after the date changes, and will consult before purchase about matching plans and ticket conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say today's inquiry is only about both-way options, you will not assume unchanged treatment across midnight, and will match plans with ticket conditions before buying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、案内にある駅と終了予定を基に候補を調べます。切符はまだ発行せず、こちらで確認内容をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check options using the station and expected finish in the guide. We will not issue tickets yet, but will explain our findings here.
